title: Gabe Newell: On Productivity, Economics, Political Institutions, and the Future of Corporations
summary: Gabe Newell of Valve speaks at UT Austin's LBJ School on productivity, economics, political institutions and the future of corporations. He discusses in-game economies and how Valve organizes work.
why: Pointed to as an in-depth view of how Valve is run and how Newell thinks about workers, management and customers.

quote.text: For an understanding of what Valve are doing, here is a 1 hour talk by Gabe Newell (CEO)
